answer_1.quote: We categorize both tasks and constraints ... we identify and compile 8 types of tasks based on traditional NLP tasks. Programming-Related tasks evaluate programming understanding through code generation, debugging, and explanation capabilities.
answer_1.outputs: Model-generated responses to multi-instruction, multi-constraint inputs

answer_2.quote: Instruction-Level Accuracy (ILA) measures the success rate of individual instructions ... Constraint-Level Accuracy (CLA) assesses the fulfillment of individual constraints ... we calculate the average score for n instances as the final metric.

answer_3.quote: We employ  as the evaluation model to assess constraint adherence in generated responses in LLM-as-judge manner ... During evaluation, the GPT-4o model serves as the evaluator.

answer_4.quote: Three certified annotation specialists perform manual review to remove redundant constraints and instructions ... we randomly selected 50 instances, comparing model scores with evaluations from three experts for contradictions, redundancy, and infeasibility.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assess contradictions, redundancy, and infeasibility of instructions and constraints.
